content.rendered:
The Scholastic Book Fair will be held at Hawks View Elementary October 20th- 28th. Students will shop during their library times during the week. On elementary conference days, the hours are as follows:

  • Thursday, October 27th – 8:00am to 8:00pm
  • Friday, October 28th – 8:00am to 10:00am.

For more information please visit our Media Center website.
